result.instructions: Tools for ByDoctor, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What appointments do we have with Dr. Silva next week?"; "Find the patient with phone (11) 98765-4321 and book a follow-up on Thursday at 14:00."; "Which appointments were changed since yesterday?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ByDoctor data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bydoctor_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bydoctor_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bydoctor_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bydoctor_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bydoctor_list_appointments
tools.title: List appointments
tools.description: List clinic appointments, oldest update first, with filters for date range, status, modality, professional, patient and room. Use updated_since to sync only what changed. Returns results[] plus next/previous cursor URLs. GET /appointments.

updated_since.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Returns only items updated from this instant.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next URL. Do not build it yourself.

tools.name: bydoctor_get_appointment
tools.title: Get an appointment
tools.description: Get one appointment by its UUID id, with patient, professional, room, type, status and times. GET /appointments/{id}.

tools.name: bydoctor_list_patients
tools.title: Find patients
tools.description: Find clinic patients by exact CPF or phone, or by partial name. CPF, e-mail, birth date and gender are never returned. Use this before creating an appointment to avoid duplicate patients. GET /patients.

cpf.description: Exact CPF, with or without punctuation. Not returned by the API.

phone.description: Exact phone in any format, e.g. (11) 98765-4321.

name.description: Partial name, case and accent insensitive.

active.description: true = active only, false = inactive only. Omit for both.

updated_since.description: ISO 8601 datetime. Returns only items updated from this instant.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next URL. Do not build it yourself.

tools.name: bydoctor_get_patient
tools.title: Get a patient
tools.description: Get one patient by id: name, phone, active flag and timestamps. GET /patients/{id}.

tools.name: bydoctor_list_professionals
tools.title: List professionals
tools.description: List the active professionals who see patients: id, name and main specialty. Use the id as professional_id. GET /professionals.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next URL. Do not build it yourself.

tools.name: bydoctor_get_professional
tools.title: Get a professional
tools.description: Get one active professional by id: name and specialty. GET /professionals/{id}.

tools.name: bydoctor_list_rooms
tools.title: List rooms
tools.description: List the active clinic rooms: id and name. Empty when the clinic does not use rooms. Use the id as room_id. GET /rooms.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next URL. Do not build it yourself.

tools.name: bydoctor_get_room
tools.title: Get a room
tools.description: Get one active room by id: name. GET /rooms/{id}.

tools.name: bydoctor_list_appointment_types
tools.title: List appointment types
tools.description: List the active appointment types, such as consultation or follow-up: id and name. Use the id as appointment_type_id. GET /appointment-types.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's next URL. Do not build it yourself.

tools.name: bydoctor_get_appointment_type
tools.title: Get an appointment type
tools.description: Get one active appointment type by id: name. GET /appointment-types/{id}.

tools.name: bydoctor_create_appointment
tools.title: Create an in-person appointment
tools.description: WRITE: books a new in-person appointment with status scheduled, for an existing patient, professional and appointment type. Teleconsults are not created by the API. Needs the appointments:write scope. POST /appointments.

patient_id.description: Patient id (find or create with bydoctor_list_patients / bydoctor_create_patient).

start_at.description: Start time, e.g. 2026-10-03T14:00:00-03:00. Seconds must be 00. Without an offset, America/Sao_Paulo is used.

room_id.description: Room id (bydoctor_list_rooms). Required when the clinic uses rooms for this slot.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same key to retry the same request safely; the API returns the first result.

tools.name: bydoctor_update_appointment
tools.title: Update an appointment
tools.description: WRITE: changes only the fields you send: start_at, professional_id, room_id, note, or status (scheduled or confirmed only). A confirmed appointment accepts only a status change; move it back to scheduled first to reschedule. Needs appointments:write. PATCH /appointments/{id}.

start_at.description: Start time, e.g. 2026-10-03T14:00:00-03:00. Seconds must be 00. Without an offset, America/Sao_Paulo is used.

tools.name: bydoctor_cancel_appointment
tools.title: Cancel an appointment
tools.description: WRITE: cancels an in-person appointment that is scheduled (move a confirmed one back to scheduled first). Repeating the cancel returns the same result. Needs appointments:write. POST /appointments/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: bydoctor_create_patient
tools.title: Create a patient
tools.description: WRITE: creates a patient record and returns its id for bydoctor_create_appointment. Search by CPF or phone first to avoid duplicates; a CPF already used by another patient in the clinic is refused (409). Needs patients:write. POST /patients.

gender.description: Required by the clinic: M, F or O.

phone.description: Mobile with area code, e.g. (11) 98765-4321 or +5511987654321.

cpf.description: CPF, with or without punctuation. Write-only: never returned.

birth_date.description: Birth date, YYYY-MM-DD. Write-only: never returned.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse the same key to retry the same request safely; the API returns the first result.

tools.name: bydoctor_update_patient
tools.title: Update a patient
tools.description: WRITE: changes only the fields you send. Send null to clear phone, email, cpf or birth_date; name and gender cannot be cleared. A CPF used by another patient is refused (409). Needs patients:write. PATCH /patients/{id}.
